description: The map a lineage review is run from: a deterministic census of the record against its raw hits (counted by code, not remembered), and for each grading lane the one question it answers and the paths it opens. A pointer, never a payload — each grader opens its own files and signs its own reading.

hits_without_url.description: Hit sources with no locator at all.

hits_secondary_locator.description: Hit sources whose locator reaches an encyclopedia, catalogue, slide deck, publisher page or other secondary surface rather than an edition or paper.

record_unverified.description: Every edge or source the RECORD marks UNVERIFIED, as it marks them.

strength_labels.description: Count of edges per strength label, as the record assigns them.

edges_internal_side_is_seat_note.description: Edges whose internal_ref is a seat's memory note or transcription rather than a sealed house artifact.

forebears_cited_twice.description: A forebear that appears under two edges or two clusters.

question.description: The one question this lane answers, stated so that a NO is possible.

unread.description: What this census did NOT open. An honest gap, stated.
